experiment: retrospective CANOE original Mode 1 explicit segment-strip diagnostic with corrected official sensor frame

frozen_scans.calibration_rule: Use only the 30 scans already marked train_calibration; no train split or frame reassignment.

georeferencing.source: Current OSM reservoir polygon plus the existing train-only CANOE-to-route translation from the frozen OSM diagnostic.
georeferencing.fit_rule: Use the existing train-only translation unchanged. Recompute train and validation pose-only route gates; stop if either fails. Never refit from validation or test.
georeferencing.sensor_to_enu_transform: Official CANOE sensor ray is [r*cos(a), r*sin(a)] in [forward,right]. Apply full scan-center M_enu_sensor_xy from C1(roll) C2(pitch) C3(yaw), then map ENU deltas to legacy renderer [right,forward] with P @ inverse(M_enu_sensor_xy), P=[[0,1],[1,0]].

independent_geometry.source: OpenStreetMap via the frozen Nominatim GeoJSON acquisition.
independent_geometry.source_geometry_version: Not exposed by the response. This geometry is not a historical 2025 shoreline snapshot.
independent_geometry.boundary_input: Polygon boundaries and interior rings only, transformed from frozen map ENU into scan-local legacy renderer coordinates using the full scan-center roll/pitch/yaw planar matrix and P axis swap. Reservoir interior is never supplied as land.

renderer.engine: TORS Mode 1 renderer using explicit shoreline segments.
renderer.mode: Original Mode 1 generic geometric coastline painter; explicit _sim_mode=SIM_MODE_M1, fixed seed 42.
renderer.source_conditioned_payloads: Reject/omit coastline profiles and statistics, object echo/support data, noise replay data, dead-zone replay data, Mode 4/42 flags, source files, scene templates, learned correction artifacts, and all objects. Disable learned-model loading and fail if a load is attempted.

coastline_buffer.construction: One explicit rectangle per consecutive nonzero external OSM boundary segment after the frozen 165 m scan-frame crop and transform.
coastline_buffer.details: Rectangles are built directly from each source segment tangent and normal. No native buffering, smoothing, polygon repair, water-interior fill, or radar-derived geometry is used. Consecutive source segments may overlap at corners; overlaps are counted and intersection areas recorded. Nonfinite, invalid, or zero-area rectangles fail the run. Zero-length/duplicate source segments are counted and skipped.
coastline_buffer.native_v1_failure: The original native line-buffer diagnostic failed before scoring on train calibration scan 1756391392147416.png because a generated native strip was self-intersecting. The v1 output is preserved; no geometry repair was applied.

renderer.mode1_painter_effects: The native Mode 1 fallback may jitter interval entry by -2 to +2 bins, randomize core code over 244-252, add a seeded 0.3-0.8 fraction of interval thickness to qualifying polygons, and add its random ramp/core-depth texture. These are renderer behavior, not fitted parameters; seed 42 fixes them. The reported 3 m refers to input strip width, not guaranteed final echo support width.

radar.angle_conversion: round(encoder * 8192 / 5600) modulo 8192; preserve source row order and duplicates.
radar.render_row_correspondence: Require exactly one renderer row per input CANOE azimuth row, exact converted angle sequence, and exactly 300 radial values. Missing predictions fail the run.

renderer.pose_approximation: Use interpolated scan-center timestamp position and full roll/pitch/yaw transform for the whole rendered scan. Report median and maximum valid-row displacement and wrapped yaw change from that center pose. Intra-scan motion is not rendered.
renderer.raw_prediction_normalization: Original output is an integer Furuno echo code in [0,252], divided by 252 for the raw renderer arm.
renderer.reference_normalization: Keep CANOE observed display echoes divided by 255 exactly as the earlier full-valid experiment. Divide original renderer codes by 252. These are dimensionless native display scales; do not rescale observations to imply common physical codes across sensors.
renderer.native_observation_support: Decode each scan with its actual native range configuration and native echo-bin count. Aggregate native bin centers to the existing 0.5 m grid, crop to [2.5,150) m, and use the same valid-azimuth, pose-supported, finite-source-cell mask for every arm. Absent cells are excluded, never zero-filled.
renderer.pose_coordinate_transform: The scan-local map bridge is planar P @ inverse(M_enu_sensor_xy), where M is C1(roll) C2(pitch) C3(yaw) from official CANOE sensor axes [forward,right] to ENU. This is not a full 3D inverse.

calibration_and_baselines.gain: Fit one nonnegative scalar by least squares on valid cells pooled across only the 30 frozen train_calibration scans, without an upper bound. Apply it to the raw /252 prediction and clip the scaled prediction to [0,1] for the display-normalized scoring domain. Record the fitted scalar and clipping fraction. No offset or other tuning.
calibration_and_baselines.range_profile: Per-radial-bin observed mean over the same 30 training calibration scans and their exact valid support, broadcast across azimuth.

occupancy_threshold.source: Exact training-only threshold already frozen in the completed CANOE OSM diagnostic.
occupancy_threshold.use: Report occupancy IoU and positive cell counts for all arms using this unchanged threshold. Do not tune to this renderer or any validation/test result.

calibration_and_baselines.scored_splits: The already-used 60-scan validation and 60-scan test traversals; retrospective only.
calibration_and_baselines.metrics: Per-scan MAE and RMSE on shared valid cells; equal-weight mean of per-scan metrics within each traversal.

interpretation_limits: This v3 diagnostic uses explicit segment-strip input; it does not reproduce native loader buffering in the full 150-scan run.
This follows the original Mode 1 renderer with a static 3 m shoreline-strip approximation; it is not exact motion-aware per-spoke rendering.
Validation and test traversals were already used in earlier CANOE analyses, so this is not fresh held-out evidence.
All three traversals share one reservoir site; report descriptive session results only.
The OSM response does not establish the shoreline geometry on the 2025 acquisition date.
Observed CANOE echoes retain /255 and renderer echoes use /252 as native dimensionless display scales; neither is claimed to represent common physical codes.
No manual shoreline labels, source capture profiles, simulator replay, or test-derived fitting are used.
